options.name: host
options.description: address to listen on

options.name: port
options.description: port to listen on

options.name: health_port
options.description: plaintext port serving only /health (0: none)

options.name: max_header_bytes
options.description: largest request header block accepted, in bytes (0: 16384)

options.name: max_result_partitions
options.description: most partitions a result is split into for a client that reads them at once (1: never split)

options.name: web_ui
options.description: serve the web UI at /ui on this port (a build that embeds it)

options.name: tls_cert
options.description: TLS certificate chain (PEM)

options.name: tls_key
options.description: TLS private key (PEM)

options.name: mtls_ca_cert
options.description: CA (PEM) client certificates must chain to

options.name: mtls_require_client_cert
options.description: refuse connections without a client certificate (false: they sign in another way)

options.name: mtls_certificate_sign_in
options.description: offer certificate sign-in (the client_certificate grant); off: certificates only admit connections

options.name: mtls_crl_allow_missing_ca_crls
options.description: accept a CA above the leaf that has no CRL in mtls_crl_file (default: refuse it)

options.name: mtls_crl_file
options.description: certificate revocation lists (PEM) for client certificates; reloaded when the file changes

options.name: mtls_identity_source
options.description: where certificate sign-in takes the identity from: san_email, san_uri or subject_cn

options.name: mtls_admin_identities
options.description: client certificate identities that sign in as the administrator

options.name: mtls_require_identity_match
options.description: a password or token sign-in over a client certificate must be for its identity

options.name: database
options.description: DuckDB database file, or :memory:

options.name: read_only
options.description: open the database read-only

options.name: memory_limit
options.description: DuckDB memory_limit, e.g. 8GB

options.name: storage_version
options.description: DuckDB storage version for new databases

options.name: allow_unsigned_extensions
options.description: let DuckDB load unsigned extensions

options.name: init_sql_commands
options.description: SQL run at startup (before the file)

options.name: init_sql_commands_file
options.description: SQL file run at startup

options.name: result_batch_rows
options.description: most rows per Arrow batch in a result

options.name: admin_username
options.description: the administrator's user name

options.name: admin_password
options.description: the administrator's password (prefer the environment variable)

options.name: secret_key
options.description: key that signs access tokens; share it across replicas

options.name: token_lifetime_seconds
options.description: access token lifetime

options.name: allow_cross_instance_tokens
options.description: accept tokens issued by other replicas

options.name: token_signature_verify_cert_path
options.description: PEM key or certificate that verifies sign-in tokens

options.name: token_allowed_issuer
options.description: required issuer of sign-in tokens

options.name: token_allowed_audience
options.description: required audience of sign-in tokens

options.name: token_default_role
options.description: role for sign-in tokens without one

options.name: token_groups_claim
options.description: sign-in token claim listing the user's identity-provider groups

options.name: token_authorized_emails
options.description: users a sign-in token may name (globs, case-insensitive; *: anyone)

options.name: token_jwks_uri
options.description: JWKS of the identity provider whose ID tokens sign users in

options.name: oauth_client_id
options.description: OAuth client id; set, browser sign-in is offered (Warp SQL oauth_browser)

options.name: oauth_client_secret
options.description: OAuth client secret (prefer the environment variable)

options.name: oauth_scopes
options.description: OAuth scopes requested

options.name: oauth_base_url
options.description: the server's public URL, for the redirect URI (default http(s)://localhost:<port>)

options.name: oauth_redirect_uri
options.description: redirect URI registered with the provider (default <base url>/warp/v1/auth/oauth/callback)

options.name: oauth_instance_id
options.description: prefix of the OAuth state, for a shared callback proxy

options.name: oauth_provider_name
options.description: the identity provider's name for people ("Sign in with <name>")

options.name: oauth_max_flows
options.description: browser sign-ins in progress at once

options.name: max_sessions
options.description: most non-admin sessions at once (0: unlimited)

options.name: session_idle_timeout
options.description: seconds an idle session lives (0: forever)

options.name: result_retention_seconds
options.description: seconds a retained result (resumable, readable again) is kept after its statement ends, from 1 to 2592000 (30 days); its statement document's expires_at says until when

options.name: query_timeout_seconds
options.description: default statement timeout (0: none)

options.name: print_queries
options.description: log every statement

options.name: rbac_store_uri
options.description: turn on role-based access control, with users, roles and grants kept in this PostgreSQL database (postgresql://user:password@host/db or 'host=... dbname=...'), which every replica of a cluster names; or, for development or a server that will only ever run one replica, in a DuckDB file of its own (duckdb:/path/to/rbac.duckdb, or a path ending in .duckdb), which one server alone may open. Use PostgreSQL in production

options.name: rbac_opa_url
options.description: also ask this Open Policy Agent decision URL about every store user's session and statement; only {"result": true} lets them run

options.name: rbac_opa_timeout_ms
options.description: how long to wait for the policy service (no answer refuses)

options.name: audit_chain_key
options.description: key that seals access-control audit records into a tamper-evident chain (HMAC-SHA256; unset: SHA-256); --verify-audit-log FILE checks a JSON log

options.name: max_concurrent_statements
options.description: statements that run at once; more wait in a queue (0: no queue)

options.name: max_queued_statements
options.description: statements that may wait (-1: 8 x concurrency; 0: unbounded)

options.name: max_queue_wait
options.description: seconds a statement may wait (-1: 300; 0: forever)

options.name: admin_bypass_queue_default
options.description: admin sessions skip the queue unless they SET hardcharger.bypass_queue = false

options.name: block_sensitive_paths
options.description: refuse SQL naming credential and system files

options.name: sensitive_paths
options.description: more paths SQL may not name (comma-separated)

options.name: block_unredacted_secrets
options.description: refuse SET allow_unredacted_secrets, even for admins

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: UUID shared by the replicas of one cluster

options.name: log_level
options.description: debug, info, warning or error

options.name: log_format
options.description: text or json

options.name: log_file
options.description: log destination (empty: stderr; -: stdout)

options.name: query_log_level
options.description: level of statement log lines

options.name: auth_log_level
options.description: level of sign-in log lines

options.name: session_log_level
options.description: level of session log lines

options.name: graceful_shutdown
options.description: on the first stop signal, let running work finish (false: stop at once)

options.name: shutdown_grace_period_seconds
options.description: how long a graceful shutdown waits for running work (0: forever)

options.name: health_check_query
options.description: SQL the health check runs

options.name: health_check_interval_seconds
options.description: seconds between health checks

options.name: health_check_staleness_seconds
options.description: age at which the last check no longer counts (0: 3 x interval)

options.name: cors_origins
options.description: browser origins allowed to call the server

options.name: enable_instrumentation
options.description: record sessions, statements and executions in SQL tables

options.name: instrumentation_db_path
options.description: DuckDB file for the instrumentation tables (default: next to the database)

options.name: instrumentation_catalog
options.description: an attached catalog (DuckLake, PostgreSQL) for them instead

options.name: instrumentation_schema
options.description: schema for them in that catalog

options.name: enable_catalog_logging
options.description: also write every log line to a logs table

options.name: log_catalog_db_path
options.description: DuckDB file for the logs table (default: next to the database)

options.name: log_catalog
options.description: an attached catalog (DuckLake, PostgreSQL) for it instead

options.name: log_schema
options.description: schema for it in that catalog

options.name: instance_tag
options.description: JSON object recorded with this instance

options.name: capture_query_profile
options.description: record DuckDB's query profile with each execution: off, standard or detailed

options.name: enable_metrics
options.description: collect runtime metrics and serve /metrics (default: on when metrics_port or metrics_bind_address is set)

options.name: metrics_port
options.description: port serving /metrics (0: none, metrics in SQL only); setting it turns metrics on

options.name: metrics_bind_address
options.description: address /metrics listens on; setting it turns metrics on
